findings.highlight: We'll be staying there together.
findings.evidenceJa: 「合宿」
findings.explanation: Kazusa names the plan a 合宿: an intensive live-in training or rehearsal camp. The English conveys only that the trio will stay together, omitting the established Japanese institutional concept that explains the booked studio, round-the-clock schedule, cooking gear, and comic severity of their week.
findings.japanese: 「合宿」
findings.todokanai: "We'll be staying there together."

findings.highlight: "Well, that's how it is, so I have to rush over to the studio now. If there's anything that either of you need me for, you know where to find me."
findings.evidenceJa:
「そんなわけだから、
あたしもすぐにスタジオ入りしないと。
あと何かあったらまた現地で相談させて」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she will consult Miyo and Youko on-site if anything else arises; 'you know where to find me' reverses who initiates later contact — Her immediate departure for the studio remains.
findings.japanese:
「そんなわけだから、
あたしもすぐにスタジオ入りしないと。
あと何かあったらまた現地で相談させて」
findings.todokanai: "Well, that's how it is, so I have to rush over to the studio now. If there's anything that either of you need me for, you know where to find me."

findings.highlight: Our stamina will be just as important as our health
findings.evidenceJa: 「この期に及んでジャンクフードとかなに考えてんだお前。これからは時間と同じくらい体力が大事だって時に」
findings.explanation: Haruki says that from now on stamina is as important as time. The English replaces time with health, producing a near-tautology—stamina versus health—and discarding the point of their 150-hour countdown.
findings.japanese:
「この期に及んでジャンクフードとかなに考えてんだお前。
これからは時間と同じくらい体力が大事だって時に」
findings.todokanai: "And what do you think you're doing, thinking about junk food during such a tight period? Our stamina will be just as important as our health in the days to come."

findings.highlight: we're only pretending to be as lax as we are
findings.evidenceJa: みんな、本当はわかってる。誰もが空元気を振り絞ってるって。
findings.explanation: All three know they are squeezing out false or forced cheer while desperately holding back tears. The English says they are pretending to be lax, replacing a brave emotional performance with casual looseness and misdescribing the banter that follows their reunion.
findings.japanese:
みんな、本当はわかってる。
誰もが空元気を振り絞ってるって。
findings.todokanai: Every one of us truly understands. We understand that we're only pretending to be as lax as we are.

findings.highlight: I understand that I'm imposing a very tough schedule. I would understand if they snapped at me for this arrangement.
findings.evidenceJa:
過酷なスケジュールだってのはわかってる。
絶対に噛みつかれるってわかってる。
findings.explanation: Haruki knows with certainty that Kazusa will bite at the schedule; 'would understand if they snapped' turns prediction into magnanimity — Her immediate objections fulfill the expected reaction.
findings.japanese:
過酷なスケジュールだってのはわかってる。
絶対に噛みつかれるってわかってる。
findings.todokanai: I understand that I'm imposing a very tough schedule. I would understand if they snapped at me for this arrangement.

findings.highlight: And it's factored into our leisure time, as well!
findings.evidenceJa: 「って、おいちょっと待て！入浴が一時間しか取ってないじゃないか！しかも移動時間込みで！」
findings.explanation: Kazusa protests that the single allotted hour for bathing even includes travel time to and from the bath. The English says bathing is factored into leisure time, inventing a schedule category and losing why one hour is especially impossible.
findings.japanese:
「って、おいちょっと待て！
入浴が一時間しか取ってないじゃないか！
しかも移動時間込みで！」
findings.todokanai: "Hey, wait, hold on a second! That means I won't even have an hour to take a bath, doesn't it! And it's factored into our leisure time, as well!"

findings.highlight: allows us 30 minutes to bathe every day
findings.evidenceJa: 入浴時間を毎日、しかも３０分延長する代わりに、睡眠時間が更に３０分短縮された…
findings.explanation: The compromise makes bathing daily and extends the originally allotted bath period by thirty minutes, in exchange for shortening sleep by another thirty. The English changes the new bath allowance itself to only thirty minutes, losing both the extension and the arithmetic of the negotiation.
findings.japanese:
入浴時間を毎日、しかも３０分延長する代わりに、
睡眠時間が更に３０分短縮された…
findings.todokanai: Our schedule now allows us 30 minutes to bathe every day, and in exchange, our time for sleep had to be cut down by the same duration…

findings.highlight: This song's been excluded since it's meant for the CD recording
findings.evidenceJa: 「ほら、この三曲目。これだけはＣＤの収録曲から外れてるだろ？」
findings.explanation: Haruki points out that the third concert piece is the sole item excluded from the CD track list. The English says it is excluded because it is meant for the CD, giving the exact opposite relationship between the two lists.
findings.japanese:
「ほら、この三曲目。
これだけはＣＤの収録曲から外れてるだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "Here, this third song. This song's been excluded since it's meant for the CD recording, right?"

findings.highlight: The album I've thought of won't include songs you'll play in the additional concert
findings.evidenceJa: 「手を抜いてるわけじゃない。効率化だ！アルバムはもちろん、追加公演での新曲はなし。いや、どれだけ譲ってもせめて１曲…」
findings.explanation: Haruki's efficiency rule is no new pieces for the album and none for the additional concert—at the absolute most, one new piece if he yields. The English instead forbids overlap between album and concert, nearly the reverse of his actual plan to maximize overlap.
findings.japanese:
「手を抜いてるわけじゃない。効率化だ！
アルバムはもちろん、追加公演での新曲はなし。
いや、どれだけ譲ってもせめて１曲…」
findings.todokanai: "We're not cutting corners, we're making things efficient! The album I've thought of won't include songs you'll play in the additional concert, of course. Well, I suppose if you absolutely insist, we could at least include one new song…"

findings.highlight: "No, we need to work with a completely new selection of songs. Including the song that resulted in my massive failure in my previous concert is a bad omen. I am not playing it again."
findings.evidenceJa:
「いいや全部新曲やる。
大失敗した前のコンサートの曲なんて縁起悪い。
二度と弾きたくないね」
findings.explanation: Kazusa rejects all pieces from the previous disastrous concert as bad luck; the English narrows this to a single song that caused her failure — Her demand for an entirely new selection remains explicit.
findings.japanese:
「いいや全部新曲やる。
大失敗した前のコンサートの曲なんて縁起悪い。
二度と弾きたくないね」
findings.todokanai: "No, we need to work with a completely new selection of songs. Including the song that resulted in my massive failure in my previous concert is a bad omen. I am not playing it again."

findings.highlight: "This is going to be my welcoming performance… one that will welcome my new world…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「歓迎の曲なんだ…
あたしの、新しい世界への…」
findings.explanation: Kazusa calls them welcoming songs directed into her new world; the English calls the performance something that welcomes the world itself — Her expression of a new self and the later audience invitation preserve the motif.
findings.japanese:
「歓迎の曲なんだ…
あたしの、新しい世界への…」
findings.todokanai: "This is going to be my welcoming performance… one that will welcome my new world…"

findings.highlight: it's just impossible for us to prepare for something that's very unlikely to be complete in time
findings.evidenceJa: 「だからって完成度の低いものを出したらどうしようもないじゃないかよ…」
findings.explanation: Haruki says that even so, putting out a low-quality or poorly polished work would be indefensible. The English makes the objection merely that the work is unlikely to be finished in time, erasing the quality threshold at the heart of his conservative program.
findings.japanese:
「だからって完成度の低いものを出したら
どうしようもないじゃないかよ…」
findings.todokanai: "Like I said, it's just impossible for us to prepare for something that's very unlikely to be complete in time…"

findings.highlight: It's frustrating to say, but I worship her too.
findings.evidenceJa: 「永遠の女神、だよね…悔しいくらい、崇拝してるもんね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna addresses Haruki: Kazusa is his eternal goddess, and he worships her enough to make Setsuna jealous. The English changes the omitted subject to Setsuna and says she too worships Kazusa, replacing romantic jealousy with shared devotion.
findings.japanese:
「永遠の女神、だよね…
悔しいくらい、崇拝してるもんね」
findings.todokanai: "Your eternal goddess, right…? It's frustrating to say, but I worship her too."

findings.highlight: she will have to be proactive and reactive
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての負荷は…衝動も反動も、かずさ一人へと収束する。
findings.explanation: Haruki says every load—both impulse and recoil, action and reaction—will converge on Kazusa alone. The English turns the paired physical forces into personality or work-style adjectives, 'proactive and reactive,' producing nonsense and obscuring why he wants a safety margin.
findings.japanese:
全ての負荷は…
衝動も反動も、かずさ一人へと収束する。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa will have to shoulder everything by herself… she will have to be proactive and reactive.

findings.highlight: our plan just underwent a disastrous rehaul
findings.evidenceJa: というか企画そのものが、青天の霹靂と呼ぶにふさわしい超企画に変貌していた…
findings.explanation: The project has transformed into an extraordinary super-project worthy of being called a bolt from the blue. The English labels the overhaul disastrous before its contents are revealed, changing surprise and scale into failure and preempting the comic reunion proposal.
findings.japanese:
というか企画そのものが、
青天の霹靂と呼ぶにふさわしい超企画に変貌していた…
findings.todokanai: I think it's better to say that our plan just underwent a disastrous rehaul…

findings.highlight: Leaving Setsuna's responsibilities aside
findings.evidenceJa: 「無理だって今さら！まだ現役の雪菜はともかく、それ俺の負荷高すぎるだろ！？」
findings.explanation: Haruki says Setsuna is one thing because she is still an active singer, but asking the long-retired guitarist to join imposes far too much on him. The English changes her continuing musical status into unspecified 'responsibilities,' obscuring the practical contrast behind his panic.
findings.japanese:
「無理だって今さら！
まだ現役の雪菜はともかく、
それ俺の負荷高すぎるだろ！？」
findings.todokanai: "With the way things are now, it's impossible! Leaving Setsuna's responsibilities aside, wouldn't that be an excessively tall task you're putting on me!?"

findings.highlight: working members of society working in different branches
findings.evidenceJa: 「あ、あのさ…俺たち、もう分別のある社会人だよな…？」
findings.explanation: Haruki appeals to the fact that he and Setsuna are now sensible, responsible working adults. The English invents their employment in different branches and omits 分別のある, destroying the setup for the narration's joke that Setsuna's fundamental irresponsibility has not changed since high school.
findings.japanese:
「あ、あのさ…
俺たち、もう分別のある社会人だよな…？」
findings.todokanai: "H-Hey, you know… the two of us are both working members of society working in different branches, aren't we…?"

findings.highlight: Let's become the three happy fools we were back then again!
findings.evidenceJa: 「ね、やろうよ！………また三人で笑い者になっちゃおうよ！」
findings.explanation: Setsuna proposes that the three of them become laughingstocks together again, directly answering Haruki's fear that Kazusa alone would bear public ridicule. 'Happy fools' turns external humiliation into private silliness and breaks the callback that persuades him.
findings.japanese:
「ね、やろうよ！
………また三人で笑い者になっちゃおうよ！」
findings.todokanai: "Hey, let's go for it! …Let's become the three happy fools we were back then again!"

findings.highlight: tens of thousands of first editions
findings.evidenceJa: 「待て、待て、待て！全国の書店で売るんだぞ！？初版○万部だぞ！？」
findings.explanation: Haruki says the initial print run is a censored number of ten-thousands of copies. The English says there will be tens of thousands of 'first editions,' confusing copies with editions and making the publishing-scale objection nonsensical.
findings.japanese:
「待て、待て、待て！
全国の書店で売るんだぞ！？
初版○万部だぞ！？」
findings.todokanai: "Wait, wait, wait! This is going to be selling in bookstores all over the country, you know!? And tens of thousands of first editions, at that!"

findings.highlight: We'll be doing a complete reenactment this time.
findings.evidenceJa: 「今度こそ完全再結成だ。………峰城大付属軽音楽同好会の」
findings.explanation: Kazusa declares that this time the light-music club will reunite in its complete three-person form. 'Reenactment' treats the performance as an imitation of a past event rather than the actual reunion whose missing third member she has just reproached them for excluding.
findings.japanese:
「今度こそ完全再結成だ。
………峰城大付属軽音楽同好会の」
findings.todokanai: "We'll be doing a complete reenactment this time. …A reenactment of Houjou High School's Light Music Club, that is."
